scope: Proof and exact linear algebra; accepted accessibility theorem is a premise
primary_model: Frozen dense tanh recurrence, P=2n^2+n, accessible open augmented endpoint family
primary_query_contract: Late arbitrary linear hidden losses, or fixed full-support scalar linear head after one freely chosen admissible recurrent input; exact gradient answers
comparison: Same h and theta, different S; identical future input and final loss
memory_model: Continuous finite-dimensional exact-real persistent state, including every history-dependent buffer; no replay or external history tape; query chosen after encoding
hidden_state_contract: nP bound for sensitivity at fixed h; n+nP total only if exact forward h also recoverable
checks: Exact rational/symbolic continuation identities, quotient ranks, restricted-head counterexample, owner-local control and archived deep matrix determinants
device: CPU; pure symbolic/rational algebra; no ML framework
stop: After mathematical report, research state and commit/push
